على and what follows it are attached to تجعل. ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾: an adverb of place attached to تجعل, and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَبَيْنَهُمْ﴾: conjoined to بيننا. ﴿سَدًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَكَّنِّي﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: the two are attached to مكني. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: fāʿil, nominative by an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, whose appearance is prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel suited to the yāʾ; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: the khabar of ما. ﴿فَأَعِينُونِي﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is the nūn of protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِقُوَّةٍ﴾: the two are attached to أعينوني. ﴿أَجْعَلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), its fāʿil latent. ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to أجعل, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَبَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place conjoined to بينكم. ﴿رَدْماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:96-98.t: ﴿آتُونِي﴾: an imperative verb; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿زُبَرَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. ﴿الْحَدِيدِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, containing the sense of condition. ﴿ساوى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to ساوى. ﴿الصَّدَفَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the response to إذا. ﴿انْفُخُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, containing the sense of condition. ﴿جَعَلَهُ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ناراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿آتُونِي﴾: its i'rab has passed shortly before; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أُفْرِغْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنا". ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: the two are attached to أفرغ. ﴿قِطْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَمَا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and ما is negative, without governing effect. ﴿اسْطاعُوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle governing the accusative. ﴿يَظْهَرُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of اسطاعوا. ﴿وَمَا اسْتَطاعُوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿لَهُ﴾: the two are attached to استطاعوا. ﴿نَقْباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هذا﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَحْمَةٌ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective), the implied form being "رحمة كائنة من ربي", and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is adverbial, conditional and non-jussive. ﴿جاءَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿وَعْدُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿جَعَلَهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿دَكَّاءَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the response to إذا. ﴿وَكانَ وَعْدُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and kāna and its noun. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَقًّا﴾: the khabar of kāna; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:99-102.t: ﴿وَتَرَكْنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَعْضَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time, and إذ is an adverb of time in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَمُوجُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِي بَعْضٍ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يموج. ﴿وَنُفِخَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي الصُّورِ﴾: the two are attached to نفخ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَجَمَعْناهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿جَمْعاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَعَرَضْنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time attached to عرضنا, and إذ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾: the two are attached to عرضنا. ﴿عَرْضاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of الكافرين. ﴿كانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي غِطاءٍ﴾: the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿عَنْ ذِكْرِي﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of غطاء, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is the wāw of the plural; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كانوا. ﴿سَمْعاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb, and the relative noun is the fāʿil. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنْ يَتَّخِذُوا﴾: أن is a particle governing the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; an and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of حسب. ﴿عِبادِي﴾: first mafʿūl bihi, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿مِنْ دُونِي﴾: the two are attached to يتخذوا, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: a particle resembling the verb, and نا is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَعْتَدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾: the two are attached to أعتدنا. ﴿نُزُلًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:103-106.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿نُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ننبئكم. ﴿أَعْمالًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم". ﴿ضَلَّ﴾: a past verb. ﴿سَعْيُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: the two are attached to ضل. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of حياة, genitive by an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هم is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَحْسَبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun; anna, its noun and its khabar stand in place of the two objects of يحسبون. ﴿يُحْسِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿صُنْعاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: the two are attached to كفروا. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَلِقائِهِ﴾: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the wāw to what precedes it, genitive like it. ﴿فَحَبِطَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَعْمالُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive and لا is negative. ﴿نُقِيمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: the two are attached to نقيم. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to نقيم. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَزْناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿جَزاؤُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿جَهَنَّمُ﴾: khabar; the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the first mubtadaʾ, ذلك. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the two are attached to جزاؤهم. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَاتَّخَذُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿آياتِي﴾: first mafʿūl bihi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَرُسُلِي﴾: a noun conjoined to آياتي. ﴿هُزُواً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:107-109.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾: conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿كانَتْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar نزلا. ﴿جَنَّاتُ﴾: the noun of kāna. ﴿الْفِرْدَوْسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نُزُلًا﴾: the khabar of kāna. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِيها﴾: the two are attached to خالدين. ﴿لا يَبْغُونَ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿عَنْها﴾: the two are attached to يبغون. ﴿حِوَلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ الْبَحْرُ مِداداً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لِكَلِماتِ﴾: the two are attached to مدادا. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَنَفِدَ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿الْبَحْرُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿أَنْ تَنْفَدَ﴾: أن is a particle governing the accusative, and an imperfect verb in the accusative. ﴿كَلِماتُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿جِئْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِمِثْلِهِ﴾: the two are attached to جئنا. ﴿مَدَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:110-110.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَنَا بَشَرٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِثْلُكُمْ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of بشر. ﴿يُوحى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is a naʿt of بشر. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يوحى. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: restraining and restrained. ﴿إِلهُكُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلهٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿واحِدٌ﴾: a naʿt; the clause is in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿يَرْجُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by an implied ḍamma on the wāw owing to heaviness; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿لِقاءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلْيَعْمَلْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَمَلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿صالِحاً﴾: a naʿt of عمل, accusative. ﴿وَلا يُشْرِكْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb in the jussive; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِعِبادَةِ﴾: the two are attached to يشرك. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:1-4.t: ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of لله. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلى عَبْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lam puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿يَجْعَلْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يجعل. ﴿عِوَجاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَيِّماً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِيُنْذِرَ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, and its fāʿil is latent; the lām and what follows it are attached to أنزل. ﴿بَأْساً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شَدِيداً﴾: an adjective. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينذر, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيُبَشِّرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative, whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil is the wāw, and الصالحات is its object, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْراً﴾: anna and its postponed noun, and لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿حَسَناً﴾: an adjective; anna and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of يبشر. ﴿ماكِثِينَ﴾: ḥāl. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ماكثين. ﴿أَبَداً﴾: an adverb of time, also attached to it. ﴿وَيُنْذِرَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَداً﴾: a past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil, and ولدا is its object; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:5-7.t: ﴿ما لَهُمْ﴾: mā is negative, and لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to علم. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; lā is redundant. ﴿لِآبائِهِمْ﴾: the two (preposition and noun) are conjoined to لهم. ﴿كَبُرَتْ﴾: a past verb for expressing blame, and the fāʿil (agent) is omitted, referring back to the word of disbelief. ﴿كَلِمَةً﴾: tamyīz (specification), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَخْرُجُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of كلمة. ﴿مِنْ أَفْواهِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تخرج. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَذِباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلَعَلَّكَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; laʿalla and its noun. ﴿باخِعٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿نَفْسَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi of باخع, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلى آثارِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to باخع. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾: puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِهذَا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative; the two are attached to يؤمنوا. ﴿الْحَدِيثِ﴾: badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿أَسَفاً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the apodosis of the condition is omitted because what precedes it indicates it. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَى الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿زِينَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi or mafʿūl li-ajlihi. ﴿لَها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to زينة. ﴿لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, and its fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the lām and what follows it are attached to جعلنا. ﴿أَيُّهُمْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَحْسَنُ﴾: khabar. ﴿عَمَلًا﴾: tamyīz, and the clause takes the place of the two objects of نبلوهم.

daas-irab:8-11.t: ﴿وَإِنَّا لَجاعِلُونَ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: mā is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جاعلون. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿صَعِيداً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿جُرُزاً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿حَسِبْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ أَصْحابَ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿الْكَهْفِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالرَّقِيمِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الكهف; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) takes the place of the two objects of حسب. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿مِنْ آياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عجبا; نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَجَباً﴾: the khabar of كانوا, and the clause is the khabar of inna [Translator's note: i.e. of anna]. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb. ﴿أَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَى الْكَهْفِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوى. ﴿فَقالُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is accusative (manṣūb) as a vocative, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿آتِنا﴾: a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and نا is the first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the speech reported. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آتنا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَهَيِّئْ﴾: conjoined to آتنا, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَنا﴾ and ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِنا﴾: both are attached to هيئ. ﴿رَشَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَضَرَبْنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَى آذانِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضربنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْكَهْفِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضربنا. ﴿سِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time, accusative by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿عَدَداً﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:12-14.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿بَعَثْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِنَعْلَمَ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the lām and what follows it are attached (mutaʿalliq) to بعثناهم. ﴿أَيُّ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْحِزْبَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿أَحْصى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أي. ﴿لِما﴾: the lām is a preposition, and mā is a relative noun in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to أحصى. ﴿لَبِثُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَمَداً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَقُصُّ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقص. ﴿نَبَأَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of فتية. ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنوا. ﴿وَزِدْناهُمْ﴾: conjoined to آمنوا; a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿هُدىً﴾: tamyīz, accusative by an implied fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility, or second mafʿūl bihi of زدناهم. ﴿وَرَبَطْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ربطنا. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿قامُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَبُّنا﴾: mubtadaʾ, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبُّ﴾: khabar, and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات. ﴿لَنْ﴾: puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿نَدْعُوَا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by lan. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ندعو, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلهاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿قُلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿شَطَطاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative.

daas-irab:15-16.t: ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: the hā is for drawing attention; أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قَوْمُنَا﴾: khabar (predicate), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آلِهَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿يَأْتُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتون. ﴿بِسُلْطانٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتون. ﴿بَيِّنٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾: khabar, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) [Translator's note: so in the source; من here is interrogative, and the clause is resumptive]. ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾: من is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to أظلم. ﴿افْتَرى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, genitive (majrūr) by على; the two are attached to افترى. ﴿كَذِباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَإِذِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذ is an adverb of time attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿اعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is a relative noun. ﴿يَعْبُدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Divine Name, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأْوُوا﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَى الْكَهْفِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أووا. ﴿يَنْشُرْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينشر. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾: fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينشر, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيُهَيِّئْ﴾: conjoined to ينشر. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يهيء. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِرفَقاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:17-18.t: ﴿وَتَرَى الشَّمْسَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and الشمس is its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of future time attached (mutaʿalliq) to its apodosis. ﴿طَلَعَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, the tāʾ being of the feminine, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَتَزاوَرُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the apodosis of the condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿عَنْ كَهْفِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تزاور, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذاتَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to تزاور. ﴿الْيَمِينِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِذا غَرَبَتْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause غربت is muḍāf ilayhi; see the i'rab of إذا طلعت. ﴿تَقْرِضُهُمْ ذاتَ الشِّمالِ﴾: see the i'rab of تزاور عن كهفهم ذات اليمين; its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي فَجْوَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar (predicate), and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ, the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿مِنْ آياتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾: conditional, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil. ﴿فَهُوَ﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْمُهْتَدِ﴾: khabar, the yāʾ having been deleted for lightness; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ﴾: its i'rab is similar to the i'rab of the preceding one; lan is a particle that puts the verb in the accusative, and تجد is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجد. ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُرْشِداً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقاظاً﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and its two objects, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ﴾: the wāw is of the ḥāl, and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ذاتَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to نقلبهم. ﴿الْيَمِينِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَذاتَ الشِّمالِ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَكَلْبُهُمْ باسِطٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿ذِراعَيْهِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi of باسط, accusative by the yāʾ because it is dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْوَصِيدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to باسط. ﴿لَوِ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿اطَّلَعْتَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the tāʾ is for the feminine [Translator's note: so in the source; the tāʾ here is the second-person pronoun and is the fāʿil]; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اطلعت. ﴿لَوَلَّيْتَ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وليت. ﴿فِراراً﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because ولّى means فرّ (to flee). ﴿وَلَمُلِئْتَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ملئت. ﴿رُعْباً﴾: tamyīz (specification).
